description: Dense dark green turf rim, slightly deeper and richer than open grass, with fine blade tips crowding together, low contrast, no soil showing.
Damp dark packed earth rim, a shade deeper than open dirt, faint crumbled clods gathered close, low contrast, no stones.
Damp packed sand, clearly darker and browner than dry open sand, fine even grain, low contrast, no ripples, no dunes.
Greyish white packed snow crust, faintly deeper and greyer than open snow, fine even granular surface, very low contrast, no blue tint, no sparkle.
Fine dark grey stone grit, a shade deeper than open rock, uniform fine grain, no pebbles, no gravel, no loose stones, low contrast.
